name: AutoComment
description: Timed automatic level-comment posting for Geometry Dash Android, with a 5-minute minimum interval.

level-id.name: Level ID
level-id.description: Numeric ID of the Geometry Dash level where comments will be posted.

comment-text.name: Comment text
comment-text.description: Comment text that AutoComment submits on the selected level.

interval-minutes.name: Reminder interval (minutes)
interval-minutes.description: Time between automatic comment submissions. Minimum 5 minutes.

enabled.name: Enable automatic posting
enabled.description: When enabled, submit the configured comment repeatedly while the main menu is open.
